name: qwen3.6-27b-awq-bf16-int4-pro6000ws-performance-256k-mtp2
notes: Performance-session RTX PRO 6000 WS profile for cyankiwi/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ-BF16-INT4 with MTP n=2. This model advertises compressed-tensors in config.json, so do not force awq_marlin; let vLLM select the compatible compressed-tensors loader. Keeps the same PRO6000WS throughput settings: max_num_seqs=8, max_model_len=262144, bfloat16 KV, prefix caching, max_num_batched_tokens=16384, and max_new_tokens=32768 so client/proxy admission control can govern active context budgets.
